comments.author: @RudimusMaximus
comments.text: We have four banks and I go into every single one and check accounts EVERY DAY. I also print out our credit reports on a yearly basis but I also go in there about twice a year to check no one is doing anything with our credit or identities. We also have notifications set anytime anything worth $10 or more is made on our accounts and credit.  We will not buy anything that we won't be able to buy in the next pay cycle and we never pay interest, since we pay on the due date.  We don't have any outstanding loans or credit debt at all. Anything large that we want to buy, from a TV or appliance or a new Vehicle.....we save up and we pay it in cash and owe nothing.
